correctness.rationale: On the full assignment board, let T and F be the positive and negative cells of a trace. Inclusion–exclusion on F sums the signed completion count for each T union U with coefficient (-1)^|U|. Nonmatchings contribute zero, and for a matching leaving two or more rows free, swapping their images cancels the signed count. At n-1 cells only the full-support term can survive, with the stated sign and magnitude one exactly for a matching. For short traces with T a matching, the residual board of order m has at most m-2 forbidden cells; a one-factorization leaves at least two surviving completions, and cancellation supplies both parities. If the support is a matching, ordinary inclusion–exclusion produces the stated factorial count before dividing by two. A match of n-1 cells has only one all-positive completion, and its sign class lacks the trace obtained by making just one cell negative: the residual two-row switch has the other sign. Heredity and the all-positive requirement give the exact shattered supports and their matching-number polynomial. Littlestone dimension is bounded by the positive child at every root, a single sign class on the board of order n-1; induction from the n=2 singletons gives n-2, matching the VC lower bound. For a deterministic tree, an inconsistent leaf has no mass, a consistent short-support leaf has zero signed difference, and a boundary leaf has absolute difference at most one. Because each parity class has n!/2 members, TV is the sum of these absolute differences divided by n!; at most 2^(n-1) leaves are possible, and the nonadaptive matching has that many unit terms. Convexity handles independent randomization, and equal priors give the stated Bayes success. The unrestricted dimensions n-1 follow by the same positive-child induction and shattering a near-perfect matching (at most m-1 forbidden residual cells). The n=2 boundary has TV one and both dimensions zero. Source verifiers and stored outputs were inspected, not executed. Independent bitset checks (python3 /workspace/review_checks.py 1) exhaust all supports and responses through size n-1 at n=2..5, including nonmatching boundary supports, and check both online dimensions. Finite checks supplement the proof.
